description: The data pipeline spans two modules. transforms.py provides strip_whitespace() and drop_empty(), while pipeline.py composes them in clean(). The stages are applied in the wrong order: drop_empty() runs before whitespace is stripped, so rows containing only spaces survive as 'non-empty', and the later strip leaves them blank. Fix pipeline.clean() so whitespace-only rows are removed, without changing either function in transforms.py.
expected_behavior: clean([{'name': '  '}, {'name': ' ok '}]) == [{'name': 'ok'}]. A row is empty when every value is blank after stripping.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Cleaning pipeline drops rows before stripping whitespace
